Options 1M, 2F, 2C and 1G are software o:
Options 1M, 2F, 2C and 1G are software only and can be enabled on any instrument. The other options require additional hardware to operate and will not appear if the hardware is not present.
Options 3C and 4C also require calibration data and will cause a processor board fault if enabled without the calibration data. Either calibrate the probes or disable the options to clear the fault.
Option 1G works by telling the instrument it has a different acquisition board. Unticking it hands the board identity back to the hardware.
